services.name: Surf and wake
services.desc: Looking for the ultimate adventure with your friends? WakeSesh offers exciting wakesurfing and wakeboarding tours on Grand Lake, CO and Horsetooth Resevoir in Fort Collins, CO, designed for friend groups who want to experience the thrill of the water together while enjoying Colorado’s breathtaking scenery. At WakeSesh, we specialize in creating fun, high-energy experiences for groups of friends: Wakesurfing is the perfect destination activity for friends’ adventures with calm waters, wide-open spaces, and stunning mountain views. services.name: Jet Ski Pickup
services.desc: Welcome to Wakesesh, your trusted source for jet ski rentals in Colorado. We provide high-quality personal watercraft rentals so you can experience the beauty, speed, and excitement of Colorado’s lakes. Whether you’re visiting for a weekend getaway or a summer vacation, Wakesesh makes it easy to get out on the water. Your safety - and the safety of others - is our top priority. All operators must follow Colorado boating laws and Wakesesh safety guidelines.
